name: story-points
description: Keeps an AI-DLC intent's unit-points.csv in step with the developers' story-point estimates: typed with /story-points:set, picked per Unit in a review form with /story-points:review, or, when Jira is configured, synced from it with /story-points:sync. Checks a Unit before it is claimed, and refuses any Jira write that lets an assistant set the story-point field.
